message.content: The decision to notify both the supervisory authority and the affected data subjects has been made based on a severity score of 3.5 (high) [F02][F05][F04]. This determination is driven by the unauthorized disclosure of 1,200 records containing names, addresses, benefit types, and PESEL numbers to an unknown recipient via an unencrypted email [F03][F02][F04][F05]. Because no mitigations were applied and the data was unintelligible, the risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects is considered high under GDPR Articles 33(1) and 34(1) [F06].
